description:
Statistical field values for one region. Pass `fields` — 1 to 5 field
codes (from /fields) — to fetch.

At SAL level, `mode=sa1` switches from the suburb-aggregate value to a
per-SA1 breakdown — every SA1 that falls inside the suburb, each with its
own values.

**Price: 3¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated field codes (from /fields). Required, 1-5 per call.

mode.description: SAL only: 'sa1' returns values for every SA1 in the suburb, instead of the suburb aggregate.

region.description: Region name (case-insensitive). For SA1, the SA1 code (SA1s are unnamed).

region_level.description: Region level: SAL (suburb), SA1, SA2, SA3, SA4, LGA, POA, GCCSA, STE, AUS.

name: area_stats_values
title: Area statistics for a region
